title: Repeater: spaced repetition flashcards that live entirely in your terminal

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Okay, so I just found the most dev core way to study. It's called repeater. And yes, it's literally flash cards in your terminal. No joke. Your cards are just markdown files sitting in your repo. You edit them in Obsidian, Vim, whatever. The algorithm FSRS targets 90% recall like it's nothing. You drill cards in this clean TE, create new ones with a built-in editor, check your stats instantly. It's Anky, but actually good for developers.
